what.text: This page follows refugees from Cambodia living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 10445 Cambodian refugees in France, 92.2% of all refugees from Cambodia.
France hosts almost all refugees from Cambodia; small numbers live in Thailand, Switzerland and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Cambodia from 1990 to 1998, with the KPNLF, KR, FUNCINPEC and the Forces of Norodom Ranariddh.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Cambodia.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at its highest point, 25344 refugees.
The figure was lower in later years, and the main years of displacement in the data are 1995 to 2011.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
